description: This is the main script for the Home dashboard page in a SuiteCRM module. It handles user preferences for dashboard layout and dashlets, loads necessary resources, and renders the homepage with various dashlets.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine instance used for rendering the homepage.

classes.name: MySugar
classes.description: Class used for managing individual dashlets, including display checks and process handling.

methods.name: checkDashletDisplay
methods.description: Checks if a dashlet should be displayed based on user permissions and context.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds the cache of dashlets if not already cached.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the dashlet, preparing it for display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns the HTML content to display for the dashlet.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header HTML for the dashlet.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns the footer HTML for the dashlet.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns any necessary scripts for the dashlet.

methods.name: shouldDisplay
methods.description: Determines if the dashlet should be shown based on custom logic.
